text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said in a statement on Friday it had sold its hydraulic cylinders subsidiary Hydoring Oy to the company's managing director and Automatik Ventiler System Oy and its main owner.
The disposed unit's net sales this year are 50 million markka and it employs 82 people, Rautaruukki said. It did not give the value of the deal.
Rautaruukki said the disposal followed its focus on the steel business and that Hydoring came to the group as part of a larger corporate arrangement in 1990.

"The company that bought Hydoring Oy's business is owned by Hydoring Oy's current managing director Timo Raikko, Espoo-based hydraulic and pneumatics firm Automatik Ventiler System Oy (AVS Oy) and its main owner Antero Parma," it said.
The company would continue operating under the name Hydoring Oy.
